figures.presentation: Render the existing cover's left efficiency panels; curves, labels and values unchanged.

Pairwise K=2 and K=8 only. Raw train VQ versus GPU hours with common twelve-update smoothing; final eval VQ bars use the paper's rounded values in pairwise-performance.json. No extrapolation.
Exact reward-tilted distribution and its mean derivative at eta=0, rendered as an image for reliable README display.
Unmodified crops of selected appendix panels: image examples a/b/e/f and video examples m/n/o, with four frames per video. Only page layout and section headings are added.
